title: Asks: every undone ask becomes a task, a close or a note (crack 2)
description: Crack #2 in core/Task/doc/cracks.md: 625 undone + 477 unroutable asks in ai/asks/undone.json. (1) A live proposal with no module_hint gets a default home. (2) One Haiku pass over the backlog: still wanted -> task, done/obsolete -> closed with a reason, a note -> a line in its module readme. Asked by mastermind-system-architect-2, 2026-10-23.

now: 2 commits in worktree task/asks-to-tasks: sweep accepts idle+approved, module from file_hint, default home = the session record (9c9104e42); UndoneAsks.settle: 625 undone = 241 tasked + 344 closed + 40 undone; real backlog 517 (40 + 477 unroutable) (88825577e). Next: a sort question in UndoneVerify + an SDK runner, Haiku 25 per batch.

Sort pass running: 21 Haiku batches of 25 (517 open asks), about $0.75 each, 4 at a time, via UndoneVerify --run (9cbedb2b3). Next: merge into the worktree's undone.json, file tasks as proposals (UndoneToTasks --proposed), write notes, re-settle, docs.

findings.text: All 232 page shots are a 404 "Page Load Error", so none of the new task pages could be checked. The new task folders exist only in the worktree `task/asks-to-tasks` (`C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/asks-to-tasks`), and the shots were taken from the main site. Every layout.json has `widest_text_sample` "404 — nothing matches …" at 1200, and `shots/…AIDashboard-tasks-make-the-dashboard-more-compact/sheet.png` shows the error at all four widths. Re-shoot the pages after the merge, or from a server running the worktree.

The sort pass filed the same ask twice as two tasks: `ui/icon/tasks/explore-icon-size-matched-to-title-size/` and `ui/icon/tasks/explore-icon-sizing-that-matches-the-tit/` both ask for icon size matched to title size. The owner gets one Approve per duplicate. Before the 233 proposals reach the owner, merge proposals with the same wording in the same module.

The written notes repeat each other. `styles/doc/notes-from-asks.md` has two "version two is built beside the current site" lines and two "token set stays minimal and reused everywhere" lines (Words: one point once).
Task titles are cut off mid-phrase with "…", for example "Explore icon size matched to title size and icon position relative to text in…". A title should be a whole short sentence (Words).

Four "Develop a YouTube content idea on …" tasks were filed under `ai/tasks/`. They are not framework work. The `ai` module is acting as a catch-all here; closing them or giving them a non-framework home would fit the owner's asks better.

answer.reply: declined: the new task pages exist only in the branch until it merges, so the main site 404s them by design. The merge is the fix; straight after it I shoot a sample of them on the main site and link the shots in the outcome.

fixed (ca6c06277): one Haiku call over the proposal titles found 11 pairs (icon size included). The later one of each is stopped "Same ask as <kept>" and its asks point at the kept task; 230 proposals wait.
